column1: # 原文\t譯文　　譯文欄留空 = 沿用原文；escape（\ddd）與 ^ 原樣保留
Soon all the power of the heavens will be MINE!\255\003All MINE!!!\255\003If only we had some nasty weather^
Hmmm^ the design's solid^\255\003But I need some waterproof material^\255\003^like cast iron, or something.
Those founding fathers are driving me nuts!\255\003Flag design changes every five minutes!
Well, as soon as I'm done with this, I'm making them a flag, ready or not!
Just about done with this^\255\003Then I'm grabbing the latest flag design and sewing it up!\255\003Then it's, `Bye-bye Betsy!`
Boy, this has taken longer than I thought.\255\003I'll never get out of here.\255\003At this point, I don't care WHAT the flag looks like!
How about an amendment that the president has to be a human being?
Maybe we should add a rule that you can't dump sludge into the water supply.
What manner of fool would do that in the first place?
What do you suppose happened to Hamilton and Madison?
Yes, I'm certain we told them Thursday.\255\003I'll wager Madison's with that woman who bakes the cupcakes again^\255\003^and Hamilton's probably gotten himself into another fight.
I bet they show up late and take all the credit for our work.
Are you sure we don't need to add anything about hideous slimy super-intelligent tentacles?
The father of our nation is cold.\255\003Better build a fire.
I guess you can have my log.
Me?  Why should I build the fire?
I'm bothered by the smoke.\255\003You build the fire.
I'm bothered by your attitude!\255\003You build the fire!
No, YOU build the fire, Mr. Penmanship!
No, YOU build the fire, log lover!
I WONDER IF THERE MIGHT BE ANY IDEAS WORTH DISCUSSING IN THE SUGGESTION BOX?
MAYBE SOMEBODY SHOULD TAKE A LOOK.
I say, lads, I have an idea.
D-d-does it have anything to do with starting a f-f-fire?
Harassing Betsy with arbitrary flag design changes is getting dull.\255\003Besides, last time she threatened to stitch me.
I was thinking it's about time we opened the suggestion box.\255\003Don't you agree?
Yes, whatever you think is fine with us.
What's he th-thinking?\255\003N-n-no one of any importance has b-been here all day.\255\003What c-c-could be in the s-suggestion box?
What's he thinking?\255\003No one of any importance has been here all day.\255\003What could be in the suggestion box?
Perhaps he intends to suggest something himself.
It says: `George says that every American should have a vacuum cleaner in their basement!`
Your n-name's on it^I'm sure you m-m-must have a good reason f-for suggesting it.
Your name's on it^I'm sure you must have a good reason for suggesting it.
^well, I'm sure I had a reason for it.
If there are no objections, we shall add it to the constitution immediately!
No?\255\003Good!\255\003And so shall it be law.
It's too early to do his hair.
I would, but who would see it?
It's all slimy and sticking together.
Sometimes I like to eat it raw.
It's a viscous liquid, probably used in cooking.
No, it would just get all gooey.
I hope this wasn't used in the outhouses.
Naw!  That would make a mess.
Need to get it charged first.
It's mine, mine, mine.\255\001The meter says it's at zero power.
The meter says it's fully powered.
FLUSH my one chance of getting out of here?\255\003Shyeah!
Just looks like a regular hammer to me^\255\003^but then I'm no scientist.
Just a plain ol' hammer, I'd say.
To me, it looks like a normal hammer.
Stop! That book's starting to put me to sleep!
Only employees are allowed to use that lab coat!
It looks more like a raincoat than a lab coat.
It looks kinda small for me.
It's covered with plans and junk.
Whatever that is, bring it here.
